provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Honda Stories: Celebrating the 30th Anniversary of Honda Type R (31 March 2023)
provenance.notes: Chassis codes of every Civic Type R generation and the year each was introduced: EK9 (1997), EP3 (2001), FD2 (2007), FN2 'Civic Type R Euro' (launched in Europe in 2007, on sale in Japan from 2009), FK2 (2015), FK8 (2017) and FL5 (2022). FD2 and FN2 are parallel models of the same period: FD2 is the four-door sold in Japan, FN2 the three-door built in Europe.

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Honda car archive (Japan): CIVIC TYPE R sales periods
provenance.notes: Sales periods in Japan, used for the years of the generations: 1997-08 to 2001-09 (EK9), 2001-10 to 2003-12 and 2004-01 to 2005-08 (EP3), 2007-03 to 2011-03 (FD2), CIVIC TYPE R EURO 2009-11 to 2012-06 (FN2), 2015-10 to 2016-03 (FK2), 2017-07 to 2019-12 and 2020-01 to 2021-07 (FK8). The specification page of the first model gives the type designation E-EK9.

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., news release: CIVIC TYPE R full model change (18 October 2001)

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., news release: CIVIC TYPE R minor model change (22 January 2004)

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., news release: TYPE R added to the CIVIC range (29 March 2007)
provenance.notes: Start of the FD2 generation in Japan.

provenance.source: Auto Express, Honda Civic Type R Black Edition ends Type R production (10 January 2017)
provenance.notes: Production of the FK2 at Swindon was over by January 2017: the last year of the generation is 2016.

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., news release: new CIVIC on sale, including the CIVIC TYPE R (27 July 2017)
provenance.notes: Start of the FK8 generation in Japan.

provenance.source: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., news release: CIVIC TYPE R minor model change (8 October 2020)

provenance.source: American Honda, Updated 2027 Honda Civic Type R Gains Sharper Performance, Heated Seats and More Standard Tech; Arriving Soon (press release, 1 October 2026)
provenance.notes: Mid-cycle update of the current Civic Type R (model year 2027 in the United States, at dealers from October 2026): revised front fascia and +R damping, same engine. Honda gives it no new chassis code, so it stays in the FL5 generation, which is still in production.
